exposure: High-grade lesion positivity in post-conization endocervical biopsy
cohort: The study included 113 patients with a positive surgical margin after cervical cold knife conization from a tertiary gynecological cancer center.
finding: Residual disease was found in about half of the patients with a positive surgical margin, and risk factors included age greater than 35 years, glandular involvement, and more than one involved quadrant.
